column1: #  Everything k4 needs from the system.
#  This table is the single source of truth: `instalar` reads it to diagnose and
#  install, and the "Requirements" table in the README comes from it. If you add
#  a call to an external program from QML or tools/, add it here in the same change.
#      check        how to know if it is present. A binary name is looked up with
#                   `command -v`; with the `pkg:` prefix the package manager is
#                   asked, for things without their own binary (fonts, Qt modules).
#      package      how it is called on Arch. A `-` means it is not packaged: we
#                   warn about it, but it cannot be installed.
#      level        `base`     without this the feature does not exist.
#                   `optional` the bar runs without it; one specific thing does not.
#      purpose      one line, shown to the user when it is missing.
#  Checked with pacman in July 2026: everything marked `base` is in Arch's
#  official repos (extra). No AUR helper is needed.
